summary: Iteration 4 covers the two additions from this round: (1) games catalog seeded with 9Wicket (brand 141, gameUId 11539) and (2) CORS locked to an ALLOWED_ORIGINS allow-list. All 7 backend pytest cases pass and the full UI flow (login as demo01 -> navigate /play-game/11539 -> iframe with real provider URL) works with exactly ONE POST /api/9wicket/launch.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS allow-list works correctly: legit preview origin gets a specific ACAO echoed back (not '*'), evil.example.com is rejected (server errors out with 500 rather than echoing the origin). No-Origin provider callbacks still pass (verified: POST /api/callback/9wicket -> 200 OK).

Cloudflare rewrites the incoming Origin from *.preview.emergentagent.com to *.cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud before Express sees it; ensure both hostnames stay in ALLOWED_ORIGINS. Currently working end-to-end.

Catalog seed produced the expected result: GET /api/global/client/play-game/11539 -> 200 with name '9Wicket'; lobby renders a '9Wicket' game card (visible in the seeded 'সব গেম' grid alongside the '9wickets' provider chip).
PlayGame single-fire guard from iteration 3 still holds after the catalog change: launch fired exactly once, response 200, iframe src = https://igamingapis.live/9w/play?t=... .

context_for_next_testing_agent: UI login recipe (verified working): (1) goto /, wait ~4s. (2) click header button with text 'লগইন'. (3) fill the two visible modal inputs (top->bottom) with demo01 / demo1234. (4) among all buttons with text 'লগইন' pick the one whose bounding_box.y > 200 (that is the modal submit; the header lookalike sits at y~12). (5) wait 4s; balance '2000' appears in DOM. Then goto /play-game/11539 and wait ~20s for launch + iframe. Manually injecting token/user into localStorage did NOT authenticate the app (context uses different keys) - use the UI flow. Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_9wicket_regression.py is stable and re-runnable; treat as regression suite for future iterations.
